title: 1.4 Children and Babies
unit_outcome: Understand and say short Spanish sentences about people, family members, and what they are doing.
goal: Name a family, a baby, the babies, and the children, and use son for who they are.
grammar_function: Una familia; Son + noun (no ellos); los + plural noun + están + action.
prerequisite: Spanish 1.1-1.3: people, el/la, es/está, y, ellos, and están.
speaking_outcome: Say who is a baby, a child, or part of the family.

cards.pedagogy_note: familia takes una.
son: es for more than one; Spanish drops ellos here.
bebé takes un.
el bebé + está durmiendo.
Plural: los bebés, están, sentados.
son for who they are; están for what they are doing.
niños: a boy and a girl together are niños, children (replaces A child; niño already means boy).
Son niños: they are children.
